Sheet2:
IF
  CLAIMTYPE IN (Institutional)
  CLAIMSUBTYPE IN (IMP)
  HOSPITALDISCHARGEDISPOSITION IN (
    1. Discharge/transfer to an Acute Hospital
    2. Statistical Discharge-Type Change
    3. Statistical discharge from leave
    4. Home/Other
    5. Discharge /Transfer to a Residential Ageing Service
    6. Discharge/Transfer to a Psychiatric Hospital
    7. Discharge /Transfer to Other Health Care Accommodation 
    8. Left Against Medical Advice
    9. DiedPatient still in hospital
   )
    AND ENCOUNTERENDDATE IS NOT NULL
    AND diagnosis exists
    AND physician exists

Else IF
  CLAIMTYPE IN (Professional)
  CLAIMSUBTYPE IN (Emergency)
  EMERGENCYDEPARTMENTDISPOSITION IN (
   1. Admitted to this hospital
   2. Non-admitted patient ED episode completed-departed
   3. Non-admitted patient ED episode completed-referred
   4. Did Not Wait
   5. Left at Own Risk
   6. Died in ED
   7. Dead on Arrival
   8. Registered
  )
    AND ENCOUNTERENDDATE IS NOT NULL
    AND diagnosis exists
    AND physician exists

THEN
    Trigger CDA Discharge Summary

nphiesencounterhospitalization if claim type institutional and claim subtype is IMP/
nphies_encounteremergency if claim type professional and claim subtype is emergency

IF

    AND ENCOUNTERENDDATE IS NOT NULL
    AND ENCOUNTERSTATUS exists
    AND diagnosis exists
    AND physician exists

THEN

Any Value exists, for example, Planned, Arrived, Cancelled, and many others. No reliance on a specific value, but it must have some value in it.
